blockdesc-compostpile-*: Turns Food, Rot, and Grass into Compost over time.
oddwire:block-handbooktext-oddwire:compo:
Construct a starter pile in the crafting grid.
Once placed, add Rot or Compost to seed it, Food to feed it, and Dry Grass to build bulk and improve airflow.
Composting works best when the pile is warm, damp, and well supplied. Temperature is best around 20-55°C; greenhouse warmth, sheltered placement, and nearby heat sources can help, but too much heat will harm it.
Moisture is best when kept damp but not soaked. Rain and watering restore moisture, while long dry periods slow the pile down.
Aeration is restored when adding material, but collapses over time, especially if the pile is boxed in by nearby blocks.
When the pile yields Compost or has collapsed, dig it up. Some Compost Pile is returned so it can be rebuilt and turned back into the process.
